summary:
Fix round 4 is applied in the repo; nothing committed, Studio untouched, no process killed. `lune run scripts/verify` is GREEN (601 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip, exit 0).

Decision 1 is adopted. Against a Ball, a flat facet (a polyhedron's face, and also a Cylinder's cap) now reads the true sphere: each piece is the circumscribed 32-gon of the circle that its plane (or its probe's plane) cuts from the sphere, R ± EPS_GEOM as the buried test asks, R + EPS_GEOM for the probe. The 32-gon's frame comes from n and the world alone (`Cover`'s `across`). The 32 lines are charged as half-spaces. A polyhedron's face keeps a Cylinder's prism; round facets keep everything, and a cap keeps its inscribed piece against a Cylinder. CoverBrute writes the same rule independently.

- Exactness: on 13,084 parts in Ball-heavy clusters the reading matches the brute force to 3.6e-13 of a part, with no tie to bracket.
- Shape: the 32-gon is exactly circumscribed (to 5e-13) and stands at most 0.0048 R past the sphere through its centre.
- Effect: V1's studs are kept (Sharpening 0.2047 Hard, the truth's row) and V1's band designs stay cleaned. V1's radial pokes that truly show 2 % or more and were cleaned go from 27/91/188/270/307/320 (r 0.2–3) to 0.
- Bit-compare against round 4's base: no verdict, measure, mass or probe moves except 14 plausible verdicts, all toward the truth (wrap-ring grips truly 2.13–2.97 %, now kept, through their lower cap against the pommel Ball). Units move on 10,364 plausible, 803 corpus and 87 fixture designs; no design crosses the cap.

O9 is written as a Decision to confirm, with both ways the band errs measured on the final tree. fixP is recorded as tried and not adopted. Every minor is applied (fixW2, fixD, CoverBrute's `away`, V1's new case, V2's text items). Unit counts are re-pinned and worst_designs.luau has new units and times. VerdictPrecision.spec passes on all six seeds, and every new test fails on the base where it should.
